releaseNotes: YancoTV 1.6.0 — recording now works reliably (scheduled recordings save real files), a rare bug that silently dropped favourites/history/resume points is fixed, and the app no longer rebuilds its whole catalogue on every launch. Adds phone swipe controls (brightness/volume/seek), guide row-height options, and in-app licences & privacy policy. Known issue: on a TV remote you can't yet skip across a long programme block in the guide — touch works. Best tried on a phone.
